name.value: Pine House Bread and Cake House

description.value: Pine House Bread and Cake House is a Chinese bakery on East Hastings Street in Vancouver, offering breads and cakes in the Chinese baking tradition. It operates out of a retail building along a busy commercial corridor, making it a convenient stop for cyclists travelling along the Hastings Street route. The shop's focus on baked goods means touring cyclists can pick up quick, portable snacks.
